authority.publisher: United States Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control

method.result_signal_for_no_match: Your search has not returned any results.
method.control_rule: A known listed ETH address must return an SDN result before target no-match observations are accepted.
method.api_capture_boundary: The official JSON search endpoint returned transfer-encoded responses. The repository SafeHTTPSFetcher deliberately rejects transfer-coded framing, so this record retains exact structured DOM observations from the official UI rather than claiming retained raw API bytes.

limitations: This is a point-in-time exact digital-currency-address screen, not a fuzzy name screen, identity verification, KYC review, legal opinion, or guarantee of future list status.
The public donor credit punk6529 is pseudonymous; address screening does not establish the donor's civil identity or screen unidentified beneficial owners by name.
This screen does not perform OFAC's 50 Percent Rule ownership analysis, transaction-exposure tracing, sanctions-program legal analysis, or screening against non-OFAC lists.
No-match means only that the official service returned no exact result for the submitted address at the recorded time.
The raw transfer-encoded API response bytes were not retained; the official UI result, control result, query settings, timestamps, and acquisition boundary are retained.
